newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank of Italy governor meets Prime Minister Prodi.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Italy governor meets Prime Minister Prodi.

text.p: Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio met Prime Minister Romano Prodi for around 40 minutes on Thursday, a government official said.
No statement was released after the meeting.
The Bank of Italy governor hinted at the weekend that a tough 1997 budget might be rewarded with an interest rate cut.
The government, which is locked in a dispute with its hard-left allies over proposed cuts to pensions and health spending, is due to unveil the budget package on Friday. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
